visualCharacteristics.purpose: One-at-a-time slider of text plus media slides (quotes with portraits, history entries, vehicles)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Image beside text in each slide, arrows at the block edges, dots below; options flip the image side, set text over a full-width photo, or show text only
notable: Scroll-snap track with prev / next and dots
Optional heading row as carousel title

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide: a media cell with a picture and a text cell (heading, quote, paragraphs, links); a first heading-only row is the title

usage: Use for a sequence of quotes, history milestones or showcase items viewed one at a time.
reuseGuidance: Fits 2-10 slides of comparable text + image; use teaser-slider for teaser cards and testimonial for a single quote.
